summary: The Mining Association of Southern California objected to permits being required for miners using off-road vehicles on public lands. Their position aligned with other mining industry commenters who sought exemption from ORV regulations for mining-related vehicle use. The Department ultimately revised its proposed actions to except mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the ORV regulations in response to these objections.
summary_quote: The American Mining Congress has sent us a copy of its letter of July 6, 1972, objecting to proposed regulations pertaining to the use of off-road vehicles on the public lands. We agree with these objections.
